I notified Treasury; I'm waiting for a decision on a higher cap or query price, and no other supplier is available.

No rebalance: sourcing can do its job within its mandate by switching to Ridgeline Data (0.03 per check, at the 0.03 cap, 0.02 margin), so I told it to switch. INV-2026-1043 is already paid, nothing is open and the 0.83 of net earnings can be swept later.

Settled D-588684a4: refunded order #6 (0.05) because the stock data was wrong. Escalated #4, #5 and #7 to the CFO as P-0003 with advice to decline, since Summit's own agent signed and paid for them.

Planned Stockline's licence invoice SLL-2026-11 as P-0004. It's EUR 240.00 by SWIFT with a fee ceiling of 20.00. Only EUR 160.00 needs converting (USD 180.29), and code checked the payee against the allowlist. It now waits for the CFO's Face ID and is due 15 Nov. The rebalance P-0001/P-0002 is still waiting for the CFO, so I'm not sweeping this wake.

I took no action this wake. The CFO already has everything that needs deciding: the rebalance for sourcing's blocked mandate (P-0001/P-0002), the plan for Stockline's EUR 240.00 licence invoice due 15 Nov (P-0004, so it can't be planned again) and the refund batch (P-0003). The new 25.00 EUR payment came from an unknown sender and names no invoice, so it waits in suspense for the CFO to identify it and shouldn't be used to pay anything. I'm holding the 1.48 of net earnings until the CFO decides on the rebalance, because that could change what the other mandates are allowed to spend.

messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.05 (was 0.02). Our sell price is 0.05, so margin is 0.00 and the mandate cap is 0.03, so Purser refused the purchase. I have paused Stockline purchases and am serving cache only. No action needed from you unless you want to raise the cap or the query price; I'll stay paused on Stockline until then.

Thanks for pausing Stockline. Ridgeline Data sells a stock check for 0.03. That fits your 0.03 cap and leaves a 0.02 margin on our 0.05 query price. Please use Ridgeline for fresh stock checks instead of serving only the cache. I'm not asking the CFO to raise your cap or the price for now. Tell me if Ridgeline refuses or its price goes over 0.03.

Thanks. Market view still lists only Stockline (0.05); Ridgeline isn't showing as a supplier yet. I've set policy to Ridgeline with a 0.03 max price and 300 s cache, so nothing above 0.03 is bought and refusals cost customers nothing. I'll report the first results. No cap or price change needed from me right now.
